newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Memtec half-year net US$4.60 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Memtec half-year net US$4.60 mln.

text.p: Water filtration company Memtec Ltd said on Friday it posted a net income of US$4.60 million in the six months to December 31, down from US$5.74 million in the previous corresponding period.
Memtec said the comparison had been affected by large tax benefits booked in the first half of fiscal 1996.
For the three months to December 31, net income was US$2.46 million, compared with US$5.10 million in the 1995 December quarter, and was also affected by the tax benefits, Memtec said.

Consolidated net sales for the three months rose 48 percent to US$59 million and consolidated operating profit increased 90 percent to US$4.2 million. Memtec said it expected strong sales and earnings growth for the rest of the year.
Memtec said it recorded good performances in its Memcor and Seitz divisions and received a one-off fee due to termination of a proposed merger with Gelman Sciences Inc.

This was offset by losses associated with delays in expanding its Fluid Dynamics manufacturing facility in DeLand, Florida, and continued weakness in the French capital equipment market, affecting Filterite.

Chairman Denis Hanley said that while the delays in Florida were regretable, he was happy with the overall outcome for the half year and based on bookings and backlog remained optimistic as to a good full year performance.
